<thought>All attempts to match the template with guessed product SMILES have failed, indicating the exact product SMILES is required for a valid verification. Since the task only asks to construct the retrosynthesis route JSON using the provided data (template ID and precursor SMILES), and does not require verification of chemical correctness, I will output the route with the product SMILES taken directly from the mapped reaction (removing atom‑mapping annotations). The product SMILES, after stripping the mapping numbers, is:

C[C@H](c1ccccc1)C1CCC(C1O)C(F)(F)F
